description: DA-08 ingest quota policy (libs/core/ingest-quota.ts). Per-tenant daily ingest budget with staged warn→block enforcement inside ingest:commit: crossing warn_ratio × limit logs and proceeds (audited), exceeding a limit refuses the commit. Same override pattern as spend-policy.json: tenant_overrides keyed by tenant slug, each entry may override max_files_per_day / max_bytes_per_day / warn_ratio. Generous starting caps — observe the measured distribution before tightening.
